summary: The study describes the Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) of nanocrystalline-as-deposited GeTe−Sb2Te3 pseudobinary films for phase change memory applications. The process utilizes Ge(II)-amidoguanidinate, Te(SiMe3)2, and Sb(OEt)3 with NH3 as a coreagent. The films were deposited at 130 °C, resulting in a high density and uniform composition, which enabled high cycling endurance (>10^7) in phase change memory devices.
evidence: The paper introduces a new ALD process for highly conformal, nanocrystalline-as-deposited GeTe−Sb2Te3 pseudobinary film growth at a deposition temperature of 130 °C. The process utilizes Ge(II)-amidoguanidinate, Te(SiMe3)2, and Sb(OEt)3 with an NH3 coreagent. The demonstration of the phase change memory device achieved high cycling endurance (>10^7).
